title: Cable fuming characteristics
description: The fuming characteristic of burning cables is an important consideration for public and safety-critical locations.

dropdownValues: On burning, a standard PVC (Polyvinyl Chloride) insulated cable produces dense black smoke and a cocktail of harmful chemicals which can cause reduced visibility and suffocation
Modified PVC, producing less smoke and HCl gas than PVC
For buildings where fire safety is critical.  Also LS0H, LSZH, 0HLS, LSNH
